panels.description: An old recording shows Mera issuing an override from a control console. Keep upper console clear.
The console rejects Mera's override with impersonal administrative text. Keep upper display clear.
Younger Mera strikes the console, then lowers her hand. Keep upper console clear.
Present Mera faces Alex in the archive, upright but no longer controlled. Keep upper archive clear.

items.text:
OVERRIDE DENIED.
INTERVENTION PARAMETERS EXCEED EXECUTIVE SCOPE.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: I had the title. The door still closed.
